targets.rawSql:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ts, '%b %Y') AS `Month`, Compliant, `Missing Story Points`, `Above Story Point Threshold`
FROM
(
  SELECT 
    DATE_FORMAT(i.created_date, '%y-%m-01') AS ts,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.story_point > 0 AND i.story_point <= 13 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Compliant`,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.story_point = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Missing Story Points`,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.story_point > 13 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Above Story Point Threshold`
  FROM issues i
  WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
    AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
    AND i.type <> 'EPIC'
    AND i.story_point = 0
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi WHERE bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ( $board_id )
    ) 
  GROUP by ts
  Order by ts desc
) base

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ts, '%b %y') AS `Month`,
  Compliant, `No Estimates`
FROM
(
  SELECT 
    DATE_FORMAT(i.created_date, '%y-%m-01') as ts,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.original_estimate_minutes IS NOT NULL AND i.original_estimate_minutes > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Compliant`,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.original_estimate_minutes IS NULL OR i.original_estimate_minutes = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `No Estimates`
  FROM issues i
  WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
    AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
    AND i.type <> 'EPIC'
    AND i.story_point = 0
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi WHERE bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ( $board_id )
    ) 
  GROUP BY ts
  ORDER BY ts DESC
) base

from issues i

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ts, '%b %y') AS `Month`, SUM(Compliant) AS `Compliant`, SUM(Orphan) AS `Orphan`, Sum(Stale) AS Stale
FROM
(
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(i.created_date, '%Y-%m-01') as ts,
    COUNT(1) AS `Compliant`,
    0 AS `Stale`,
    0 AS `Orphan`
  FROM issues i
  WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
    AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date) 
    AND i.creator_id IN ($developer_id)
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi WHERE bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ($board_id)
    )
    AND i.assignee_id IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(i.assignee_id) <> ''
    AND i.status LIKE 'IN_PROGRESS'
    AND i.type <> 'EPIC'
    AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), i.updated_date) <= 14
  GROUP BY ts
  UNION
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(i.created_date, '%Y-%m-01') as ts,
    0 AS `Compliant`,
    COUNT(1) AS `Stale`,
    0 AS `Orphan`
  FROM issues i
  WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
    AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date) 
    AND i.creator_id IN ($developer_id)
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi WHERE bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ($board_id)
    )
    AND i.assignee_id IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(i.assignee_id) <> ''
    AND i.status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
    AND i.type <> 'EPIC'
    AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), i.updated_date) > 14
  GROUP BY ts
  UNION
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(i.created_date, '%Y-%m-01') as ts,
    0 AS `Compliant`,
    0 AS `Stale`,
    COUNT(1) AS `Orphan`
  FROM issues i
  WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
    AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
    AND i.type NOT IN ('EPIC', 'BUG')
    AND i.status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
    AND i.creator_id IN ($developer_id)
    AND (i.assignee_id IS NULL OR TRIM(i.assignee_id) = '')
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi WHERE bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ($board_id)
    ) 
  GROUP BY ts
) base
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts DESC

select i.issue_key as `Issue Key`, i.title AS `Title`, i.type AS `Type`, i.creator_name AS `Creator`, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(i.assignee_name), ''), '(Unassigned)') AS `Assignee`, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), i.updated_date) AS `Days since Last Activity`, i.url AS `Link`
from issues i
WHERE i.id LIKE '%jira:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
  AND i.type <> 'EPIC'
  AND i.status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
  AND i.assignee_id IN ($developer_id)
  AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), i.updated_date) > 14
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi where bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ( ${board_id} )
  )
ORDER BY i.updated_date ASC;

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(num_month, '%b %y') as `Month`, 
  SUM(Compliant) AS Compliant,
  SUM(`No Description`) as `No Description`,
  SUM(`Under Threshold`) AS `Under Threshold`
FROM
(
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(i.created_date, '%Y-%m-01') as `num_month`,
    COUNT(1) AS `No Description`,
    0 AS `Under Threshold`,
    0 AS `Compliant`
  FROM issues i
  WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
    AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
    AND i.creator_id IN ( $developer_id )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi WHERE bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ($board_id)
    )
    AND (i.description IS NULL OR TRIM(i.description) = '') 
    GROUP BY `num_month`
  UNION
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(i.created_date, '%Y-%m-01') as `num_month`,
    0 AS `No Description`,
    COUNT(1) AS `Under Threshold`,
    0 AS `Compliant`
  FROM issues i
  WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
    AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
    AND i.creator_id IN ( $developer_id )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi WHERE bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ($board_id)
    )
    AND i.description IS NOT NULL 
    AND CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(i.description)) < 100
  GROUP BY `num_month`
  UNION
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(i.created_date, '%Y-%m-01') as `num_month`,
    0 AS `No Description`,
    0 AS `Under Threshold`,
    COUNT(1) AS `Compliant`
  FROM issues i
  WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
    AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
    AND i.creator_id IN ( $developer_id )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi WHERE bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ($board_id)
    )
    AND i.description IS NOT NULL 
    AND CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(i.description)) >= 100
  GROUP BY `num_month`
) base
GROUP BY `num_month`
ORDER BY `num_month` DESC

list.definition:
WITH scoped_issues AS (
  SELECT bi.issue_id
  FROM board_issues bi
  WHERE bi.board_id IN ( ${board_id} )
    AND bi.board_id LIKE 'jira:%'
),
scoped_accounts AS (
  SELECT ia.assignee_id AS account_id
  FROM issue_assignees ia
  JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = ia.issue_id
  WHERE ia.assignee_id LIKE 'jira:%'
  UNION
  SELECT i.creator_id
  FROM issues i
  JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE i.creator_id LIKE 'jira:%'
  UNION
  SELECT ic.author_id
  FROM issue_changelogs ic
  JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = ic.issue_id
  WHERE ic.author_id LIKE 'jira:%'
  UNION
  SELECT w.author_id
  FROM issue_worklogs w
  JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = w.issue_id
  WHERE w.author_id LIKE 'jira:%'
)
SELECT CONCAT(
         REPLACE(COALESCE(
           NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''),
           NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), ''),
           NULLIF(TRIM(a.email),     ''),
           '(unmapped)'
         ), '-', ' '),
         '--', a.id) AS Name
FROM accounts a
JOIN scoped_accounts sa ON sa.account_id = a.id
GROUP BY Name
ORDER BY Name;
